prerequisites: Successful completion of the modules to be completed in the 1st and 2nd semester according to the study plan.
Knowledge of mathematics and technical mechanics taught in the basic courses of mechanical engineering
Knowledge of "Grundlagen der Mechatronik und Systemtheorie"
Knowledge of "Model-based Design of Mechatronic Systems"

learning_outcomes.text: Students have the methodological basis for calculating and simulating technical systems.
They are able to list application examples.
They are able to model independently different technical single and multi-body systems and simulate them using relevant software tools.
Furthermore, the students are able to analyze the system behavior of the modeled system with software tools.

syllabus_topics: In-depth treatment of programming aspects important in engineering
Application of learned material in exercises
Software-supported analysis of real application examples from the specialization using Python
Application of Simulink for control engineering analysis
Modeling, simulation, and control design using Simulink with real application examples
assessment_rules: The module final examination can be a written exam (150 minutes) or an oral exam (30-45 minutes). The allocation of credit points is granted if the module final examination is passed. The module is weighted by its ECTS credit points (factor: 1) for the overall grade.
